register.labelZh: SMASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: smash something down 可以清楚描述門、閘、牆和其他障礙物被擊倒或撞開。；smash something in 可以描述某個表面受到猛烈撞擊後向內凹陷或塌下。；smash something up 適合用來描述傢俬、機器、房間、店舖或其他地方被嚴重砸毀。；這些表達常見於意外、救援工作、財物損毀、電影和故事的描述中。
register.summaryEn: Smash something down helps you describe doors, gates, walls and other barriers being knocked over or forced open. Smash something in describes a surface that has been hit so hard that it bends or caves inward. Smash something up is useful when furniture, machines, rooms, shops or other places have been very badly damaged. These expressions often appear in reports about accidents, rescue work, damaged property, films and stories.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 SMASH 片語動詞。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the SMASH expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 留意三者表示的不同結果:smash a door or wall down — 把門或牆擊倒,或猛力撞開smash a surface in — 把表面撞至向內凹陷、塌下或破裂smash a thing or place up — 把某物或某地方砸得嚴重損毀；使用名詞時,以上兩種位置均可能使用;使用 it 或 them 時,則把它放在 SMASH 和 DOWN、IN或 UP 中間。；額外片語可以補充行動的方法、原因或時間,但並不是核心片語動詞的一部分。以上句子的核心表達是 smashed the door down;with a heavy tool 只說明警員如何把門撞破。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Notice the different results: smash a door or wall down — make it fall or force it open smash a surface in — hit it until it bends, breaks or caves inward smash a thing or place up — damage it very badly or destroy it With a noun, both positions may be possible: smash the door down / smash down the door smash the panel in / smash in the panel smash the room up / smash up the room With it or them, place the word in the middle: smash it down / smash it in / smash them up An extra phrase may explain how, why or when the action happened, but it is not part of the core expression. The police smashed the door down with a heavy tool. Core expression: smashed the door down with a heavy tool only explains how the police did it.
